user.title: LokalTerm setup
user.description: Add the LokalTerm integration and enter your local boiler connection details.

data_description.name: Friendly device name shown on dashboard cards and in the device registry.
data_description.devid: Controller/module identifier required in command frames.
data_description.devpin: Device PIN used to authorize local LAN control frames.
data_description.listen_host: TCP server bind address in Home Assistant (default 0.0.0.0).
data_description.listen_port: TCP port receiving boiler status frames (default 1088, range 1-65535).

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname.
error.invalid_port: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535.
error.port_in_use: This port is already used by another LokalTerm entry.
error.cannot_bind: Cannot bind to the selected TCP address or port (already in use or insufficient permissions).
